name: Newsletter
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes Blocks (e.g. `Newsletter(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

description.default: Subscribe for occasional updates, product insights, and early news from our team.

NewsletterPerk.description:
One Newsletter perk: an outline icon tile and a line of text.

  NewsletterPerk(icon: :template) { "Premium templates" }

examples.name: Usage
examples.notes:
The Appica homepage section, on its dark panel. Without `action:` it's a demo: submit a
valid address to see the thank-you; an empty or invalid one shows the field's error.

examples.name: Form only
examples.notes: No perks or social links - just the pitch and the form.
examples.code:
phlex do
  Newsletter(title: "Get the changelog", description: "One email a month with everything we shipped.", class: "w-full max-w-md")
end

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes: Rendered in Arabic whatever the toolbar says; the arrow mirrors.
examples.code:
phlex do
  I18n.with_locale(:ar) do
    div(dir: "rtl", class: "w-full max-w-2xl") do
      Newsletter(socials: SOCIALS) do
        NewsletterPerk(icon: :sparkles) { "تحديثات رئيسية للمكتبة" }
        NewsletterPerk(icon: :template) { "قوالب مميزة" }
      end
    end
  end
end
